title: UPC Generation
description: Single-source derived material (summary, rating, translation, classification, description). Inputs live in provenance.derived_from (the single source of truth for the graph edges); provenance.input_digest enables staleness. A rendered output is pinned by output.sha256; any quotation in it is gated by hop C (§04).

path.description: Corpus-relative path to the rendered output (e.g. generated/summary.md).

value.description: Inline structured output (e.g. a rating object), when not a file.

sha256.description: Hex sha256 of the output file's bytes; required at L2 for a path output (rule output_hash_mismatch).
